name: fresh-news feedback ON + hold-winners + incumbent prompt framing
description: Prompt-fix arm: identical to fresh_news_hold_winners.json except prompt_framing=incumbent. The controlled contrast for whether telling the model it still OWNS its book (rather than that the book was liquidated) reduces the winner-selling that costs this strategy its INIT gap.
notes: WHY THIS EXISTS: every one of the 324 runs so far sends a rebalance prompt that
says 'Your entire previous portfolio has already been SOLD ... Rebuild the
portfolio from scratch'. That is a DEFAULT-SELL framing: no incumbency, every
name re-justified from zero against a fresh candidate list.
It is also factually WRONG under rebalance_mode=hold, where only the delta is
traded. That mismatch shows in the data: hold_winners has the best returns AND
the worst swap edge of the three arms.
swap edge (forward return of DROPPED minus ADDED names, per decision)
feedback_on   -1.64pp
feedback_off  -0.22pp
hold_winners  -2.61pp   <- execution was fixed, the prompt was not
WHAT CHANGES (prompt only; no engine, news, candidate or cadence change):
1. DEFAULT-KEEP. 'YOUR CURRENT HOLDINGS (NOT sold - you own these right now)',
plus 'anything you leave unchanged simply stays as it is'.
2. HORIZON. 'Your next opportunity to change this portfolio is in N months; a
name you drop today you cannot re-buy until then.' The model was previously
blind to cadence, yet a bad swap costs -4 to -6.5pp at 2x and about 0 at 12x.
3. SWITCHING HURDLE. 'Only swap a name out if your conviction in the replacement
is MATERIALLY higher - not merely equal, and not because the incumbent has
already risen.'
FEEDBACK ISOLATION: with feedback ON the book is shown WITH per-name performance;
with feedback OFF it is shown as STATE ONLY (names, shares, value, weight - no
returns), so an OFF arm would still receive no performance signal. Feedback is ON
here to match fresh_news_hold_winners.json.
EVERY option below matches fresh_news_hold_winners.json except 'prompt_framing'
and 'results_subdir'. That is what makes this a controlled contrast - do not
change the gate, cadence, order mode or screening in only one arm.
DO NOT touch the news corpus between this arm and hold_winners. A re-screen or
backfill changes which cells pass the gate and silently breaks the pairing.
Runs land in results/portfolio_sim/hold_incumbent/ and are tagged '_hold_inc' in
the filename. Compare against results/portfolio_sim/hold_winners/.
